description: This file implements a semantic versioning (semver) library in Go, defining the Version struct, comparison methods, parsing functions, and related utilities for handling semantic versions.

classes.name: Version
classes.description: Represents a semantic version with major, minor, patch, prerelease, and build metadata.

classes.name: PRVersion
classes.description: Represents a prerelease version component, which can be numeric or alphanumeric.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Converts a Version to its string representation.

methods.name: FinalizeVersion
methods.description: Returns major.minor.patch string, discarding prerelease and build info.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if two Version instances are equal.

methods.name: EQ
methods.description: Alias for Equals.

methods.name: NE
methods.description: Checks if two Version instances are not equal.

methods.name: GT
methods.description: Checks if Version v is greater than o.

methods.name: GTE
methods.description: Checks if Version v is greater than or equal to o.

methods.name: GE
methods.description: Alias for GTE.

methods.name: LT
methods.description: Checks if Version v is less than o.

methods.name: LTE
methods.description: Checks if Version v is less than or equal to o.

methods.name: LE
methods.description: Alias for LTE.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares two Versions, returning -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: IncrementPatch
methods.description: Increments the patch version.

methods.name: IncrementMinor
methods.description: Increments the minor version.

methods.name: IncrementMajor
methods.description: Increments the major version.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the Version fields.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Parses a version string into a Version pointer.

methods.name: Make
methods.description: Parses a version string into a Version.

methods.name: ParseTolerant
methods.description: Parses a version string with some leniency, normalizing input.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a strict semver string into a Version.

methods.name: MustParse
methods.description: Parses a version string or panics.

methods.name: NewPRVersion
methods.description: Creates a new prerelease version component.

methods.name: IsNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a prerelease version is numeric.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares two prerelease versions.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Converts a PRVersion to string.

methods.name: NewBuildVersion
methods.description: Creates a new build version string.

methods.name: FinalizeVersion
methods.description: Returns version string without prerelease and build info.
